description: Do the relocalization architecture decisions transfer? The single-task reloc1 recipe (100k steps, same common flags) on mental_rotation-banana and object_scaling-canned_food, starting from the selected option (A0) and undoing one decision at a time: A1 drops the wrist goal views, A2 the copy:0.5 stem init, A3 early fusion. Two seeds each, machine 2, offline only (Tier A on the eval50 test set; no tierB, no base run, so no 20k kill rule). Each GPU runs its chain in order (`after`).
